api_key.description: `apikey` required by Porkbun API. Can also be configured using the `PORKBUN_API_KEY` environment variable.

custom_base_url.description: Override the default base URL (https://porkbun.com/api/json/v3) used by Porkbun API client. Can also be configured using the `PORKBUN_CUSTOM_BASE_URL` environment variable.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries to perform when an API request fails (default to 4). Can also be configured using the `PORKBUN_MAX_RETRIES` environment variable.

secret_api_key.description: `secretapikey` required by Porkbun API. Can also be configured using the `PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY` environment variable.

content.description: The answer content for the record. Please see the DNS management popup from the domain management console for proper formatting of each record type.

name.description: The subdomain for the record being created/updated/deleted, not including the domain itself. Leave blank to target the root domain. Use * for a wildcard record.

notes.description: Comments or notes about the DNS record. This field has no effect on DNS responses.

priority.description: The priority of the record for those that support it.

ttl.description: The time to live in seconds for the record. The minimum and the default is 600 seconds.

type.description: The type of record being created.Valid types are `A`, `MX`, `CNAME`, `ALIAS`, `TXT`, `NS`, `AAAA`, `SRV`, `TLSA`, and `CAA`

block.description: Create DNS records for your domain.

id.description: The ID of the glue record (format: domain:subdomain).

ips.description: The IP addresses for the glue record.

subdomain.description: The subdomain of the glue record (e.g., 'ns1').

block.description: Manage glue records (nameserver IP addresses) for your domain.

nameservers.description: An array of nameservers that you would like to update your domain with.
An array of nameserver host names.
